_comment: FM-1 pre-migration snapshot lock for EDGE-NRI.
_shift_notes_S77e_step4: Classification (i) FIXTURE-WAS-WRONG — hand-written payload authored as a desired shape, not derived from buildLoanPayload(). Corrections: (1) purchaseType 'Direct Sale' → 'resale_normal' (valid V2 option value); (2) propertyType 'Villa' REMOVED — no V2 schema question binds propertyType; villa is expressed via constructionType='House' (schema label 'House/Villa'); (3) constructionStatus 'Ready to Move' → 'House' (builder maps constructionType answer → constructionStatus; RTM is expressed via propertyStage); (4) propertyStage 'Ready To Move' added (flagKey on propertyLocation for resale_normal); (5) carpetArea/carpetAreaUnit/carpetAreaRaw added from propertyCharacter page; (6) residence fields (residenceState/residenceCity) REMOVED — residenceOptionSame='Yes' → residenceSameAsProperty=true with no residence state/city keys emitted (same-as-property branch); (7) sellerOwnershipType/propertyAcquisitionMethod/sellerOnLoan/lastRegistryDuration/isAnyBuilderDemand added from sellerTransaction_homeLoan; (8) documentationReadiness ['SALE_DEED','EC'] added; (9) registryTimeline/auctionPropertyStatus added from dealFinancials; (10) titleChainStatus/encumbranceCertStatus REMOVED (showWhen requires CONVERTED_RESIDENTIAL/OLD_MUNICIPAL/LOCAL_COLONY/UNKNOWN, not PLANNED_AUTHORITY); (11) ocCcAvailable NOT added — requires constructionType='Flat', hidden for House; (12) hasNRIApplicant on loanTransaction NOT added — builder reads applicationData.ApplicantIsNRI/hasNRIApplicant (loanTransaction.ts line 366), but the journey threads NRI only via applicant.isNRI (applicantPayload.ts line 112-126), so the transaction-level flag is not synthesized. Same drop pattern as HL-BT-TOPUP applicationStructure. (13) grossIncome/netIncome REMOVED from applicant — Self-employed(Professional) path in applicantPayload.ts doesn't set them (only Salaried path does). (14) businessProfile added via businessActivityDetailsVisible (snake_case option keys → buildBusinessProfile camelCase booleans); gstRegistered stays false (doctors typically unregistered). (15) financials added via financialsTableVisible. (16) gpaDetails: isNRI='Yes' + gpaFullName/gpaAge/gpaRelationship/gpaAddress raw applicant keys → gpaDetails {fullName,age,relationship,address} (applicantPayload.ts line 117-125).
